items.task: Write and export `hasTitle(tasks, query)`: true when any task title contains the trimmed query, case-insensitively. A match on the LAST task must be found.

tests.name: finds a match on the last item
tests.code: assert.equal(mod.hasTitle([{ title: 'Read a book' }, { title: 'Write a test' }], 'TEST '), true);

tests.name: finds a match on the first item
tests.code: assert.equal(mod.hasTitle([{ title: 'Read a book' }, { title: 'x' }], 'read'), true);

items.wrongBecause: off-by-one loop bound: the search fails only at the last item (the transfer's exact symptom)
